title: Explore quad-preserving boolean operations
description: Research how to perform CSG boolean operations while preserving quad topology. Current mesh_boolean triangulates everything, breaking downstream nodes that expect quads. Options to explore: 1) Re-quadrangulation post-boolean (instant quads, catmull-clark). 2) SDF-based boolean + dual contouring remesh. 3) Topology-aware face classification that preserves quads where possible. Goal: determine feasibility and pick a path forward.
definition-of-done: 1. Research document with pros/cons of each approach. 2. Recommendation for which approach to implement. 3. Prototype of recommended approach (can be rough).
testing-plan: 1. Compare boolean output topology (quad ratio) before and after. 2. Visual comparison of boolean results with current triangulating approach.
